valuation.method: Forward adjusted EPS x P/E. Each case uses FY2027 adjusted EPS (the year an investor at the 2027-11-18 target date is pricing). Anchors: Q3 2026 adjusted EPS $1.94, nine-month adjusted EPS $4.40, 2026 adjusted EPS outlook raised to $4.70 (from $4.50-4.60), management guiding 8-9% adjusted EPS growth through 2028 and expecting to raise the upper end of 2027-2028 ranges; about 1,157 million average shares in Q3 2026. The exact 2027 guidance range was not retrieved, so FY2027 EPS values are our assumptions off the $4.70 base. Multiples are judgement against regulated-utility forward ranges, not broker targets. Listing is a US common share in USD, so no ADR or FX conversion applies.

bear.driver: Data-center load ramp slips, rate-case outcomes and rising financing costs trim growth, and utility multiples compress

base.driver: Delivery of 2026 guidance and about 7.5% growth into 2027 on rate base growth and data-center demand, within the 8-9% company path

bull.driver: 8-9% growth path met with upper-end guidance raises and data-center capital upside, supporting a premium multiple

valuation.implied_by_close: At base FY2027 EPS of $5.05 the close of $93.59 implies 18.5x (19.9x on 2026 EPS of $4.70). The only named target found ($112, TD Cowen, March 2026) implies 22.2x on base EPS, or FY2027 EPS of about $5.89 at 19x.
valuation.sensitivity: One turn of P/E moves the base target by $5.05 (5.4% of the close, 5.4 percentage points of price return). A $0.10 change in FY2027 EPS at 19x moves it by $1.90 (2.0 pp).
valuation.watch_metric: Adjusted EPS growth versus the 8-9% path, with weather-normalized sales growth (3.5% in Q3 2026) and data-center usage (up 59% in Q3) as leading indicators.
valuation.next_disclosure: Q4 and full-year 2026 results, expected around February 2027 (date not yet announced), where 2027 guidance will be updated.

analyst_notes: Only one named analyst call in the last 12 months was found with a verifiable date: TD Cowen's Shelby Tucker raised to $112 from $108 (Buy) on 6 Mar 2026, before the Q3 beat and 2026 guidance raise, so it is stale relative to last earnings. Other firm-level targets (Raymond James $104 and Mizuho $105 in May 2026) were not attributed to named analysts and are excluded. The $112 target implies roughly 22x base EPS against our 19x, a 20 percentage point gap to the close-based base case, which would need FY2027 EPS near $5.89 at 19x.
